title: random animated pixel art sakura tree idk
author: image by JpegIsMe
description:
lore time! so i typed 'animated pixel art sakura tree' into google and clicked on the first thing i saw, the image was on artstation so i created an account just to ask for permission from the guy if i can use it, next day i see bro deleted his account to avoid replying to me, his account was dead with no new upload for like 3 years, so i tried reaching him on discord but his server was so dead i can guarantee my message is still the last thing there lol, so now this image is basically lost media, not feeling super comfortable using it but i figured he will never contact me so...
ill probably draw my own version later, from what i saw i think he was in a MrBeast vid like ones and the status got to his head cuz saying no is ok but ghosting is evil
